(1) we provide the first efficient and secure training protocols for a variety of NNs, including CNNs; (2) these protocols can be used to train networks that achieve high accuracy; (3) we show that the efficiency of secure protocols is not much worse than the cleartext implementations, even when training on a large dataset.

we provide novel protocols for NN training and prediction in a secure setting that are (1) information theoretically secure (2) efficient and (3) can be used to train networks that achieve >99% accuracy.
we provide the first information-theoretically-secure NN training protocols that are efficient, scalable and practical.
